note: Actors and actions reported by external web sources, gathered 12 August 2026. Kept strictly separate from the verified tracking: nothing here enters the counts, matrices or maps. Each entry states only what its linked source reports. Entries marked as social posts are self-published by the actor or by local pages and carry the weakest verification of anything on this site.

updates.action: A KfW delegation inspected reconstruction work in blocks 45 and 58 of the Nahr el-Bared camp and said it would support resolving the heritage question and secure the remaining financing to finish the project and return residents. This is the long-running camp reconstruction programme, separate from 2024 and 2026 war damage.

updates.actor: UNDP & Ministry of Social Affairs (Haneen Sayed)
updates.action: Recognised 120 Ministry of Social Affairs coordinators and volunteers for supporting displaced families during the conflict - the coordination backbone of the shelter response.

updates.actor: Presidency & Council of Ministers (Joseph Aoun, Nawaf Salam)
updates.action: A new round of Lebanon-Israel talks opened in Rome on 4 August; President Aoun reported 'positive progress' on borders and prisoners, with the talks covering the ceasefire, the demolition of homes, and 'pilot zones' for recovery.

updates.actor: Ministry of Public Works and Transport
updates.action: The ministry began building an alternative passage beside the destroyed Qaaqaiyet ej-Jisr bridge to restore crossing while the bridge itself awaits reconstruction - a bypass, explicitly not the rebuild.

Teams reported completing damage assessment, beginning rubble clearance and installing temporary structures, while delivering humanitarian aid and preparing for residents' return in southern villages.
updates.sourceName: Meir Amit ITIC (Israeli research institute; attribute accordingly)

updates.actor: UNIFIL & Municipality of Tyre (Mayor Hassan Dbouk)
updates.action: UNIFIL's commander took part in a transfer-of-assistance ceremony to the Municipality of Tyre; the mayor said the assistance strengthened the municipality's ability to keep providing services to residents.
updates.sourceName: Meir Amit ITIC (Israeli research institute; attribute accordingly)

updates.actor: Local authorities at the Qaaqaiyet ej-Jisr crossing
updates.action: An alternative passage was opened alongside the river bridge until the bridge can be rebuilt.

updates.actor: Residents and volunteers of Zaoutar el-Gharbiyeh
updates.action: Voluntary debris clearance at the Deir Saidat el-Bachara site, described by organisers as a first step toward rebuilding the community. Zaoutar el-Gharbiyeh is one of the villages covered by the 'pilot areas' arrangement.

Technical committees reported completing the first phase of surveying completely and partially destroyed houses in Zaoutar el-Gharbiyeh, in preparation for delivering prefabricated homes to residents. A survey phase and an announced intention, not delivered housing.
The first phase of damage assessment was reported under way ahead of the delivery of prefabricated houses to residents.

Signed a US$3 million partnership ('Empowering Public Services with Solar Energy - Lebanon') to equip seven priority public institutions with solar photovoltaic systems and energy-efficiency upgrades in support of recovery.

The Prime Minister instructed the relevant authorities to accelerate rubble removal, road reopening, infrastructure reconstruction and the restoration of essential services as the first phase of recovery in south Lebanon.
